cases.title: deployed by path: the loop collapses

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: "export async function main() { return 100 }"
        input_transforms: {}
    - id: l
      value:
        type: forloopflow
        iterator: {type: static, value: [1, 2, 3]}
        modules:
          - id: x
            value:
              type: rawscript
              language: bun
              content: "export async function main(x: number) { return x }"
              input_transforms: {}

cases.note: A deploy does not reduce the preprocessor module to stored nodes (OF-3), so its bodies run as inline raw flows, in which a for loop never collapses and a while loop still does (CF-V5). The preprocessor loop itself has a branchall body, so it does not collapse either.
cases.title: the preprocessor module's bodies run as raw flows

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  preprocessor_module:
    id: preprocessor
    value:
      type: forloopflow
      iterator: {type: static, value: [1]}
      modules:
        - id: p
          value:
            type: branchall
            branches:
              - modules:
                  - id: f
                    value:
                      type: forloopflow
                      iterator: {type: static, value: [1]}
                      modules:
                        - id: x
                          value:
                            type: rawscript
                            language: bun
                            content: "export async function main() { return 1 }"
                            input_transforms: {}
                  - id: w
                    value:
                      type: whileloopflow
                      modules:
                        - id: y
                          value:
                            type: rawscript
                            language: bun
                            content: "export async function main() { return 1 }"
                            input_transforms: {}
  modules:
    - id: a
      value: {type: identity}
